# Guilherme Vigneron de Oliveira — Portfolio

> This is the personal portfolio of Guilherme Vigneron de Oliveira, a Principal Software QA Engineer with 18+ years of experience.

## Summary
Principal Technologist with 18+ years of experience advancing software quality, engineering velocity, and developer experience. Grounded in quality engineering and automation, my work spans DevOps, software development, daily AI/LLM engineering workflows, and company-wide DX Snapshots that turn org-wide feedback into action.

## Experience
- Principal Software QA Engineer at AVEVA (Nov 2023 - Present), Austin, TX
  - Organized company-wide Developer Experience (DX) Snapshots and analyzed org-wide results to uncover engineering bottlenecks and inform priorities.
  - Expanded into DevOps and software development, building CI/CD pipelines, release automation, and engineering deliverables in Azure DevOps.
  - Integrated LLMs and AI-assisted workflows into daily engineering to accelerate development, testing, and data analysis while maintaining quality.
  - Led comprehensive test strategies and robust Selenium/C# automation frameworks, increasing test coverage and reducing defects.
  - Conducted critical performance testing to optimize software scalability and reliability.
  - Led cross-functional teams as a Scrum Master, fostering collaboration and driving sustained sprint delivery.
- Senior QA Engineer at AVEVA (Sep 2018 - Nov 2023), São Paulo, Brazil
  - Headed the development of test strategies, increasing test coverage and reducing defects.
  - Designed a robust Page Object Model test framework using Selenium and C#.
  - Orchestrated testing processes using Azure DevOps release pipelines.
  - Mentored junior QA engineers, improving team productivity and knowledge sharing.
- Quality and Test Analyst at AVEVA (Oct 2008 - Sep 2018), São Paulo, Brazil
  - Led the implementation of a risk-based testing approach, prioritizing test cases based on business impact.
  - Pioneered the implementation of new test automation tools.
  - Collaborated with cross-functional teams to optimize the software development lifecycle.
  - Developed and delivered comprehensive training programs on testing techniques for QA analysts.

## Selected Projects
- guilhermevigneron.dev — Self-Verifying Portfolio & Resume Pipeline (https://github.com/guilhermevigneron/guilhermevigneron.github.io)
  - Zero-third-party static showcase driven by a single resume.json source of truth. Compiles fingerprinted bundles, Schema.org JSON-LD, llms.txt, vCard, Open Graph card, and A4 /resume.pdf, gated by HTML5 validation, Playwright mobile Web Vitals budgets, and 16-audit WCAG 2.1 AA Cypress + axe checks.
  - Enforces strict default-src 'self' CSP with SHA-256 asset fingerprinting, subsetted Geist fonts, and responsive AVIF/WebP imagery.
  - Publishes live CI telemetry to /quality/ and /quality/report.json alongside weekly production smoke and link-rot checks.
